jewellers_workshop_1 = {
	construction_time = construction_time_6_months

	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes
		OR = {
			county = { has_potential_for_trade_good = trade_good_type:trade_good_gold }
			county = { has_potential_for_trade_good = trade_good_type:trade_good_silver }
			county = { has_potential_for_trade_good = trade_good_type:trade_good_gems }
			county = { has_potential_for_trade_good = trade_good_type:trade_good_jade }
		}
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes

	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_1_cost

	province_modifier = {
		prosperity_growth = medium_prosperity_tier_1
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = resource_tier_1_main_income
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = resource_tier_1_main_income_tribal
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_category_jewelry_materials_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
		trade_category_precious_metals_sell_price_mult = price_metal_building_1
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good_category = trade_category_jewelry_materials
		amount = guild_precious_stones_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_jewelry_production_add = jewelry_outpout_per_need_mines
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = resource_tier_1_main_income
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = resource_tier_1_main_income_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good_category = trade_category_precious_metals
		amount = guild_precious_metals_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_jewelry_production_add = jewelry_outpout_per_need_mines
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = resource_tier_1_main_income
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = resource_tier_1_main_income_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	next_building = jewellers_workshop_2

	type_icon = "resource_buildings/jeweller.dds"
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_need_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_jewelry }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_resource_building_consumer_need_category_modifier = { CATEGORY = trade_category_jewelry_materials }
		ai_resource_building_consumer_need_category_modifier = { CATEGORY = trade_category_precious_metals }
		ai_income_building_modifier = yes
		ai_market_shortage_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_jewelry }
		ai_resource_new_building_modifier = yes
	}

				trade_good_jewelry_production_add = jewelry_outpout_per_need_mines
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = resource_tier_1_main_income
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = resource_tier_1_main_income_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good_category = trade_category_precious_metals
		amount = guild_precious_metals_resource_need
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 3
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_jewelry_production_add = jewelry_outpout_per_need_mines
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = resource_tier_1_main_income
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = resource_tier_1_main_income_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	next_building = jewellers_workshop_4

	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_need_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_jewelry }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_resource_building_consumer_need_category_modifier = { CATEGORY = trade_category_jewelry_materials }
		ai_resource_building_consumer_need_category_modifier = { CATEGORY = trade_category_precious_metals }
		ai_income_building_modifier = yes
		ai_market_shortage_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_jewelry }
		ai_resource_building_upgrade_modifier = { LEVEL = 3 }
	}
}

jewellers_workshop_4 = {
	construction_time = construction_time_2_years

	district_level_requirement = {
        value = 5
        if = { limit = { has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active } value = 0 }
    }
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes
		OR = {
			county = { has_potential_for_trade_good = trade_good_type:trade_good_gold }
			county = { has_potential_for_trade_good = trade_good_type:trade_good_silver }
			county = { has_potential_for_trade_good = trade_good_type:trade_good_gems }
			county = { has_potential_for_trade_good = trade_good_type:trade_good_jade }
		}
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes

	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_4_cost

	province_modifier = {
		prosperity_growth = medium_prosperity_tier_4
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = resource_tier_4_main_income
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = resource_tier_4_main_income_tribal
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_category_jewelry_materials_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
		trade_category_precious_metals_sell_price_mult = price_metal_building_1
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good_category = trade_category_jewelry_materials
		amount = guild_precious_stones_resource_need
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 4
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_jewelry_production_add = jewelry_outpout_per_need_mines
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = resource_tier_1_main_income
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = resource_tier_1_main_income_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good_category = trade_category_precious_metals
		amount = guild_precious_metals_resource_need
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 4
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_jewelry_production_add = jewelry_outpout_per_need_mines
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = resource_tier_1_main_income
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = resource_tier_1_main_income_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	next_building = jewellers_workshop_5

	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_need_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_jewelry }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_resource_building_consumer_need_category_modifier = { CATEGORY = trade_category_jewelry_materials }
		ai_resource_building_consumer_need_category_modifier = { CATEGORY = trade_category_precious_metals }
		ai_income_building_modifier = yes
		ai_market_shortage_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_jewelry }
		ai_resource_building_upgrade_modifier = { LEVEL = 4 }
	}
